# Config: Greeter

> **Reader:** `GreeterConfig` (`config/GreeterConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.Greeter` · category Screen & Power

Login screen: Axiom as your login screen (a greetd greeter), laid out on the Layouts page like the lock screen. It runs as greetd's own user from a copy of axiom installed for it, and shows what axiom exports for it here: no root is needed to change it once it's set up.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `Greeter`

- **`Greeter.enabled`** · boolean = false
  - Set up as the login screen (set by its card's Install and Remove, never by hand).
  - x-takeover=true, x-settings=false
  - read: `GreeterConfig.enabled` · in: `services/GreeterManager.qml`, `services/OverlayManager.qml`
- **`Greeter.source`** · string = "git" · enum git|local
  - Code from: Where Install and Update take the login screen's code. Git fetches it as root from the repository axiom was installed from, following releases or main as axiom's updates do: nothing that can write to your clone can change it. Local copies your clone as it is (the checked-out branch, uncommitted changes included), for working on axiom: any program running as you could change what the login screen runs before you next update it.
  - x-showIf={"/$packaged":false}
  - read: `GreeterConfig.source` · in: `components/forms/GreeterSetup.qml`, `services/GreeterManager.qml`
- **`Greeter.monitor`** · string = ""
  - Login monitor: The monitor the login box shows on. The others show the layout without it, or only the background.
  - x-options="screens"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.monitor` · in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- **`Greeter.rememberUser`** · boolean = true
  - Remember the last user: Start on whoever logged in last, and on their last session. Off starts with an empty user field.
  - read: `GreeterConfig.rememberUser` · in: `services/GreetdManager.qml`

### `Greeter.layout`

- **`Greeter.layout`** · object
  - A screen of overlay modules on a bounded grid of columns × rows units, fitted to each monitor: the built-in lock screen (Lockscreen.layout) and the greeter (Greeter.layout).
- **`Greeter.layout.columns`** · integer = 16 · 4–32
  - Columns: Grid units across. The grid is stretched to fill each monitor, so match your screen's shape (16 × 9 for 16:9).
  - x-group="Grid"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole), `// reads:` marker · in: `components/methods/GridPlacement.qml`, `config/GreeterConfig.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.rows`** · integer = 9 · 2–32
  - Rows: Grid units down.
  - x-group="Grid"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole), `// reads:` marker · in: `components/methods/GridPlacement.qml`, `config/GreeterConfig.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.fineGrid`** · boolean = false
  - Double grid: Split each grid unit in two each way, for finer placement. Modules keep their size and spot.
  - x-group="Grid"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole), `// reads:` marker · in: `components/methods/GridPlacement.qml`, `config/GreeterConfig.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.contentScale`** · integer = 100 · 50–200 · %
  - Content size: Size of the modules' text and content, against what the overlay shows on each monitor (which follows Overlay size and content size). Columns and rows set how big the cards are.
  - x-group="Grid", x-control="stepper"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole), `// reads:` marker · in: `components/surfaces/screenlayout/ScreenLayoutView.qml`, `config/GreeterConfig.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.otherScreens`** · string = "layout" · enum layout|background
  - Other monitors: What monitors other than the one with the password field show.
  - x-group="Grid"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.background`** · string = "wallpaper" · enum wallpaper|color
  - Background: Each monitor's wallpaper, or a plain color.
  - x-group="Background"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.blurWallpaper`** · boolean = true
  - Blur wallpaper
  - x-group="Background", x-showIf={"background":"wallpaper"}
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `config/GreeterConfig.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.backgroundColor`** · string = "base00"
  - Color
  - x-group="Background", x-options="colors", x-showIf={"background":"color"}
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `config/GreeterConfig.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.dim`** · integer = 40 · 0–100 · %
  - Dim: Darken the background so the modules stand out.
  - x-group="Background", x-control="slider"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `config/GreeterConfig.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.moduleBorders`** · boolean = true
  - Module borders: Draw each module's card box. Off shows modules straight on the background. The password field and the greeting have their own switches.
  - x-group="Style"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.passwordBorder`** · boolean = false
  - Password field border: Draw a card box around the password field.
  - x-group="Style"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.greetingBorder`** · boolean = false
  - Greeting border: Draw a card box around the greeting.
  - x-group="Style"
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.modules`** · array<OverlayModules> = []
  - x-settings=false
  - read: `GreeterConfig.layout` (whole) · in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- **`Greeter.layout.modules[]`**: one of the [OverlayModules](OverlayModules.md) types (discriminated by `type`)

### Reader members

Every public member of `GreeterConfig`, with the files that use it.

- `GreeterConfig.enabled` (bool): Set up as the login screen (GreeterManager's install)
  - in: `services/GreeterManager.qml`, `services/OverlayManager.qml`
- `GreeterConfig.monitor` (string): Where the login box shows: a monitor name, empty for the primary
  - in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- `GreeterConfig.rememberUser` (bool)
  - in: `services/GreetdManager.qml`
- `GreeterConfig.source` (string): Where Install and Update take the code: "git" (the upstream, fetched by root, on SelfUpdate.channel) | "local" (the clone as it is)
  - in: `components/forms/GreeterSetup.qml`, `services/GreeterManager.qml`
- `GreeterConfig.layout` (var): The login screen's ScreenLayout, as saved (the greeter shows the saved one; the layouts editor's draft is GreeterManager.editor.localLayout)
  - in: `components/surfaces/greeter/GreeterSurface.qml`
- `GreeterConfig.fieldGroups` (var): The layout's own fields in groups (`x-group`), for the layouts editor
  - in: `components/views/layouts/GreeterTarget.qml`
